_comment: Reused, not refit: intercept/w_implied/w_trailing/pts_to_td_ratio/league_rush_share are fit ONLY on real, played season < 2026 data (2022-2025 play-by-play + schedules). The hourly live-refresh job reuses these constants as-is every run -- it never refits them. Only implied_total (live Vegas lines) and trailing_off_tds / rush_share (updated once a week, after real games are played) change between runs. Regenerate this file only when a new season of played data should be folded into the fit (i.e. once a year, not once an hour).
